title: Bee Removal in Bronxville, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Bronxville, Westchester. Licensed experts treat and remove nests from homes and businesses. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal throughout Bronxville. Our licensed technicians understand the unique challenges of stinging insect nests in Westchester's suburban setting — from paper nests in wall voids and soffits to carpenter bee galleries in eaves and trim — and respond quickly to protect your family and property with targeted nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing.
whyUs: We combine over 15 years of pest control experience with specialized bee removal expertise specific to Bronxville's mix of historic homes and modern properties. Our team prioritizes humane relocation methods whenever possible and guarantees complete hive removal to prevent future infestations.
localContext: Bronxville's tree-lined streets, Tudor and Colonial-style homes, and proximity to the Bronx River Parkway create ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in eaves, soffits, wall voids, and mature landscaping. Carpenter bees bore into the exposed wood trim common on period homes. From properties near Lawrence Park to homes along Pondfield Road, we're familiar with the architectural features that attract stinging insect activity in this charming village — and how to locate hidden nests inside those structures.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Bronxville?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Bronxville?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in Bronxville?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service for wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket removal throughout Bronxville and Westchester County. Because active nests in wall voids, eaves, or near entryways pose safety risks — especially during warmer months when colonies are largest — we prioritize rapid response to protect your family and neighbors.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: Our service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing every entry point to prevent recolonization at the same location in your Bronxville home. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
